name: Xin Yuan Enterprises Group Limited
summary: Xin Yuan Enterprises Group Limited, established in 2010 and based in Fuzhou, is an investment holding firm providing asphalt tanker chartering in China, Hong Kong and Singapore. Its segments are asphalt tanker chartering, bulk carrier chartering and asphalt trading, using asphalt tankers on time and voyage charters and second-hand Capesize ships on bulk time charters.
